question: Midazolam 0.05–0.1 mg/kg given orally or intramuscularly approximately 30–60 minutes before induction is a commonly used anxiolytic premedication in adult patients.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Midazolam at 0.05–0.1 mg/kg (oral or IM) is indeed standard. Check your dose range for benzodiazepine premedication — doses above 0.1 mg/kg increase the risk of respiratory depression and prolonged sedation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Midazolam is the most widely used benzodiazepine for premedication. The oral dose is typically 0.05–0.1 mg/kg (maximum 7.5 mg); the IM dose is 0.07–0.1 mg/kg, given 30–60 minutes before induction for peak effect.
